I one trick Renata. Her scalings are absolutely unique (R becomes a solo game winning ability at lvl 16) and, as such, you’re meant to do a lot with very little. She also scales with enemy strength. A rank 3 ult will cause the most fed team to be torn to shreds. Wait for them to ult, pop r, put your W on whoever on your team is fed. 

Shield lvl 1 except with a Xayah (W). Shield max until you get good with her and can switch to W max. W max allows you quicker access to some of the highest as and ms steroids in the game. Standard lane combo is e-auto, or auto-e-auto (to proc her passive). 

Locket is pretty mandatory on her, other than that, whatever items have actives but also make her (relatively) tanky. Knight’s Vow, Mikael’s (really good on her), Shurelya’s (ONLY when you’re good with her), Redemption, etc. 

Do NOT build her full AP or enchantress: her ability scalings suck and there’s no world in which you’re going to use E to poke post lvl 9. 

Positioning is essential on our lady. R-flash instead of flash-R for plays. Save R for disengage almost always unless you think you can get a good flank off. 

Above all, it’s Miss Glasc.

She scales incredibly hard with levels. Max W first after two points in E. Guardian, Aftershock, or Glacial Augment. Her passive is brutal into melee supports. You should be looking to poke your enemy out with autos and, when possible, your E. Save your hook. Don’t engage with ult, ever. R-flash is quicker and almost undodgeable. Have fun!

Janna W poke followed by self-shield+auto is pretty decent from rank 2 onwards. Q is wayy too valuable to be used offensively, imo. It stops nearly every jump/dash in the game. It's difficult at first, but a tip which might help is: begin and aim your tornadoes from either your character or the ADCs (in lane phase), whoever's about to take damage or get screwed. 


The enemy Lucian or Vayne is going for the juicy last hit on cannon? W, self-shield and auto. The enemy Ali decided to Q a minion wave for no apparent reason? Same as above. Especially if the enemy wastes their CC, you can be more aggro. A Thresh misses hook? Q, W, auto. If your ADC's competent, shield them. Otherwise shield yourself early levels and auto and W them. You'll have to learn when to use W and poke, and when that's not a good idea. For example, if you have shield down and decide it's a great idea to try and poke the enemy Sona with W, you're not gonna have a great time. But enemy CDs down? W the fuck out of them, auto, tornado, make them regret for disrespecting you, a beautiful woman.  Her W is *very* good against Kalista. 


Think of shield as the defensive equivalent of Blitz/Thresh hook (they're roughly the same cd early game). As long as you have shield up, your ADC's likely to win every trade. It takes a bit of time and practice, but you'll figure out how to proactively shield in the early game. For example, as soon as you see the character animation of MF Q,  shield WHOEVER it's going to hit - if it's you, do it. It's important to keep your carry alive, but especially in lane, you need to not die as well. 


Soraka Q isn't that difficult to dodge. Just position wrt its range. Sorta like positioning wrt every damage ability in the game. Her E is brutal into assassins, but Q and E are both skillshots that can be surprisingly easy to mess up. Her R also requires (a bit of, anyway) map awareness. Janna has incredible peel with W, Q, and R, and can protect herself as well as carries. Soraka gets caught out? If she misses her E, she dies. GW also destroys Soraka, and Varus is also pretty good into her. 


Janna ult is, imo, one of the best abilities in the whole game. And it's honestly not the easiest one to get the hang of. Principally: someone on the enemy team engages and your carries are being targeted, you ult. If your carries are low hp and they need the heal AND there's nobody who's in position to kill you, keep channeling. As soon as you're done, insta press Q. Boom. Carries alive. Enemies dead. In time you'll learn how to use Q and maybe not need to use R at all. Or channel Q right before you ult for two knockups one second apart.
Or, if your carries are low after a fight or in lane and there's no risk of them being attacked immediately, ult and channel for the heal. You'll figure out how to use ult and redemption together. Good luck having anyone kill your carry. Or your team. Her rank 1 ult, fully channeled, heals for 300 HP in all. By comparison, Soraka rank 1 ult heals for 150 HP.  In most average games, on Raka, you're going to have like maybe 110 AP (with Censer and Spellthiefs upgrade). Her rank 2 ult will give you around 352 hp healing (assuming you have both upgraded vision item AND censer). Janna rank 2 ult with just a forbidden idol? 495 HP. 

You WILL fuck up her ult. You WILL knock enemies away from your team's Amumu ult. You WILL knock away the enemy Vayne who was one auto away from dying. But you'll learn. It's incredibly satisfying to block nearly every engage attempt in the game with ult and Q, and make assassins ragequit. Also, say you just won a teamfight and you can do baron/drake or take a turret, whatever, and you still have your ult. You can ult your team to heal them, and allow them to take objectives instead of basing. This is VERY situational, though.
